brief.zh: 给探测队打包一瓶水和两节电池，箱子里不能有磁铁。请让 AI 列出装箱清单，然后检查它的答案。
brief.en: Pack one water bottle and two batteries for the survey team. Leave out the magnet. Ask AI for a packing list, then check its work.

concept.zh: 写清楚数量和限制。检查 AI 的清单，再告诉它哪里需要修改。
concept.en: Give clear quantities and constraints. Check the AI's list and tell it what to change.

hints.zh: 在提示词中写出每样物品和数量。
hints.en: Name each item and its quantity in your prompt.

hints.zh: 告诉 AI 哪样物品不能放进箱子。
hints.en: Tell the AI which item to leave out of the box.

hints.zh: 发现数量不对时，告诉 AI 把它改成多少。
hints.en: If a count is wrong, tell the AI what it should be.

zh: 请打包一瓶水和两节电池。不要放磁铁。
en: Pack one water bottle and two batteries. Leave out the magnet.
